title: Pool tags
description:
Track allocations by their four-character tags and find leaks.

```
alloc 64 'XnEc', alloc 128 'XnLg', alloc 32 'XnEc'
free one 'XnEc'
leaks: 'XnEc' 1 block (32 bytes), 'XnLg' 1 block (128 bytes)
```
hints: A per-driver tag prefix makes `!poolused` output easy to search.
requirements: Tags are 4 characters packed into a `std::uint32_t` (the first character in the lowest byte, as WinDbg shows them reversed in memory).
`allocate(size, tag)` returns an id; `free(id)` must use the same tag or is reported.
Print the leak report sorted by bytes.
stretch: Print the tags the way `!poolused` does, with the characters in reading order.
